name: Zigzag wave C complete
idea: After a zigzag correction whose wave C went beyond the end of wave A, a signal on the first close back beyond the last smaller swing of C (or the end of wave B). The mirror: a rising zigzag. Wrong beyond the extreme of wave C. The count is an interpretation.

params.label: Wave size (swing degree the waves are counted at)
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history. Reference: 1.

params.label: Bars for the average true range
params.help: Bars for the average true range the break distance is measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Break distance beyond a level, in average true ranges (0: any close beyond)
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond). Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars a setup stays watched after the count moves on
params.help: After the count moves on, how many bars the setup is still watched for its close beyond the level. Reference: 20.

params.label: Zigzag trigger: the last smaller swing of C, or the end of B
params.help: The level the close must go back beyond: the last smaller swing inside wave C (used only when it lies beyond the end of wave A, else the end of wave B), or always the end of wave B (later, more patient).
choice_labels: The last smaller swing inside wave C

params.label: Only when wave C is inside the C-to-A zone
params.help: Optional: only when wave C, as a multiple of wave A, is inside the zone below.

params.label: C-to-A zone: from (multiple of wave A)
params.help: The near edge of the C-to-A zone, as a multiple of wave A. Reference: 0.618.

params.label: C-to-A zone: to (multiple of wave A)
params.help: The far edge of the C-to-A zone, as a multiple of wave A. Reference: 1.618.

constraints.message: The C-to-A zone must start before it ends.

setup.long: FibEw("zigzag_c_entry", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, zz_trigger=$zz_trigger, c_zone=$c_zone, c_min=$c_min, c_max=$c_max)
setup.short: FibEw("zigzag_c_entry", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, zz_trigger=$zz_trigger, c_zone=$c_zone, c_min=$c_min, c_max=$c_max)

invalidation.long: FibEwLevel("zigzag_c_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, zz_trigger=$zz_trigger, c_zone=$c_zone, c_min=$c_min, c_max=$c_max)
invalidation.short: FibEwLevel("zigzag_c_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, zz_trigger=$zz_trigger, c_zone=$c_zone, c_min=$c_min, c_max=$c_max)
